bull_case: N2/A16 and advanced packaging deepen TSMC's role as the performance/capacity bottleneck for AI compute.
bear_case: Geopolitical concentration, customer concentration and global-fab cost dilution are the main structural offsets.
thesis: TSMC is the structural leader in dedicated foundry and a core bottleneck supplier for leading-edge compute. Its edge combines process technology, yield learning, customer trust, capacity scale, packaging and ecosystem depth.

evidence.claim: 2Q26 advanced nodes were 77% of wafer revenue.

counterevidence: Overseas fabs carry structurally higher costs; customer concentration and Taiwan/export-control tail risks remain material.
unknowns: AI/HPC demand duration beyond the current capacity-constrained cycle
falsifiers: A sustained loss of leading-edge share, repeated yield delays, or owner FCF/share stagnation despite rising capex would weaken the thesis.

key_kpis.name: owner FCF/share
key_kpis.threshold: sustained growth through the capex cycle

next_checks: 3Q26 results, N2 ramp, CoWoS/advanced packaging capacity, overseas-fab margin, top-customer concentration

subscores.rationale: AI/HPC and advanced compute require increasingly complex leading-edge manufacturing and packaging.
TSMC defines the commercial leading-edge foundry benchmark across process, yield, capacity and ecosystem.
HPC, smartphone, IoT/auto and specialty/packaging provide several demand axes, though customer concentration is high.

uncertainties.rationale: AI-cycle duration, overseas economics and geopolitical/customer concentration remain material uncertainties.
